title: Customer Support Associate
description:
Nexa BPO Services is hiring Customer Support Associates for its Kolkata voice process.

Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound and outbound customer calls in Bengali, Hindi and English.
- Resolve customer queries and log every interaction in the CRM.
- Follow up with pending leads until closure.
- Send confirmation emails to customers after each interaction.

Requirements:
- Must have 1-3 years of experience in customer support or telecalling.
- Required: excellent communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
- Experience with outbound calling and follow-up calling.
- Comfortable with MS Word and Excel for daily reporting.
- Graduate in any discipline.

Nice to have: prior experience in real estate or BFSI. Rotational shifts apply.
